{"command": "python - <<'PY'
import cv2,numpy as np
v=list(map(int,open('qr_code.txt'))); d=cv2.QRCodeDetector()
for rev in (False,True):
 for inv in (False,True):
  for pad in (4,8):
   m=np.array([[(x>>(j if rev else 28-j))&1 for j in range(29)] for x in v],np.uint8)
   if inv:m=1-m
   # bit 1 means black
   im=np.pad(255*(1-m),pad,constant_values=255)
   im=cv2.resize(im,None,fx=10,fy=10,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
   data,pts,_=d.detectAndDecode(im)
   print(rev,inv,pad,repr(data),pts is not None)
PY"}

  print(rev,inv,repr(data),pts is not None)
